title: Embed Visual Studio Code in Business Central
summary: Embedding Visual Studio Code's Monaco editor in a Business Central control add-in provides a text viewing and editing experience for displaying large blocks of text such as integration requests, responses, or imported file contents.
key_points: Monaco editor can be embedded in a Business Central control add-in
Improves on the WebPageViewer add-in for text handling
Suitable for displaying large text blocks from integrations or imported files
Provides both viewing and editing capabilities

quotes.text: We can embed Visual Studio Code's Monaco editor in a control add-in for a lovely text viewing and editing experience.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core capability and benefit of the solution being presented

quotes.text: Maybe the request / response from some integration. Maybe the contents of a text file that has been imported.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains practical use cases where embedded text editors are valuable in Business Central
